prds.title: Quick Capture requirements
prds.problem: Collect ideas through a focused capture dialog and a reviewable inbox.
prds.audience: Obsidian users who need adapt for notes, bookmarks, meeting intake or a personal inbox.
prds.goals: Adapt for notes, bookmarks, meeting intake or a personal inbox.
prds.nonGoals:
Validate and persist notes atomically
Choose append/create behavior and protect filenames
prds.notes: All requirements are designed, not implemented or verified.

requirements.title: Capture inbox
requirements.acceptance: Given the capture inbox surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Captured item
requirements.acceptance: Given the captured item surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Native lifecycle and data safety
requirements.acceptance: Given the plugin is enabled then disabled, all subscriptions, timers and UI resources are released; no unrelated notes or settings are changed.

requirements.title: Isolated acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Given an isolated development vault and synthetic data, verify the intended outcome with a failing test before implementing it. Scaffold tests and synthetic examples do not satisfy this acceptance.
